name: Bit-packed Voxel Rendering via Vertex Texture Fetch
definition: A technique to render a 128x128x128 voxel grid by packing voxel existence data into 4 separate 128x128 RGBA images, where each pixel's 32 bits represent 32 voxels along the Z-axis. The vertex shader samples these textures to determine voxel presence and projects vertices accordingly, using vertex texture fetch.
summary: Bit-packed Voxel Rendering via Vertex Texture Fetch renders voxel grids by packing existence data into RGBA textures, allowing vertex shaders to sample bits for efficient culling of empty space.
